text:
maria: heads-up — when I try to download a filtered slice from the log-inspector (last 24h, event_type=key.rotate) the CSV omits kms_key_id on some rows. @raj can you repro?
raj: looking now. which workspace? I tried quick export and saw a couple of blank kms_key_id too. possibly schema v2 vs v1 mismatch when we normalize before export.
oliver: I think the issue is the new RBAC change that hides certain KMS metadata for non-admins. AuditViewer role shouldn't see raw key IDs, but the export is still including the column header which confuses customers.
sasha: that's not good — customers expect consistent columns. We should either drop the column entirely when masked or fill with "<redacted>". Prefer explicit redaction.
maria: agreed. also pagination bug: the CSV writer stops after first page if the cursor header is missing. repro steps:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/events?limit=100" \
  | jq -r '.events[] | @csv' > page1.csv
# next page via cursor: ?cursor=eyJv... but inspector UI isn't sending cursor on download
```
raj: oh that's a separate frontend bug — UI download triggers /audit/export which currently uses initial query + assumes no cursor. I'll add a quick fix to stream across cursors.
tina: another edge: when export is requested with format=jsonl we currently inline base64 payloads for event.payload and customers can't parse due to missing content-type. Example schema snippet we send:
```json
{"ts":"2026-09-12T14:00:00Z","event":"access.grant","actor":{"id":"u_123"},"payload":"eyJrZXkiOiJrZXktaWQifQ=="}
```
We should include payload_encoding="base64" or decode for json exports.
raj: noted. also KMS integration: if the export service runs in customer-managed VPC it can't call KMS in the control plane due to trust boundary. We need to either decrypt on-prem before export or provide encrypted export and let customer KMS unwrap.
maria: customers asked for an endpoint to validate event schema before they ingest: suggested `POST /audit/validate` returning list of missing fields and examples. That would catch v1/v2 drift.
oliver: +1, saves support tickets. I'll draft an RFC for API change and UI behaviour: show columns removed/ redacted in the preview and make download respect the preview.
sasha: permissions question — should AuditViewer be able to request exports at all? Current policy allows downloads if they have `audit:read` but not `audit:export`. Maybe split the perm.
tina: for immediate mitigation I recommend: 1) mask kms_key_id values with "<redacted>" consistently, 2) fix UI download to page until cursor=null, 3) add payload_encoding metadata for jsonl, 4) add export permission flag. I'll open a PR for 1+2.
raj: I'll own pagination PR. maria can you file the product ticket for /audit/validate and permission split?
maria: filing now -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-8421
audit-bot: export job 1871234500-1 completed for workspace=acme, format=csv, size=2.4MB :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks. follow-ups: include sample curl in the ticket for customers to reproduce, and note SLO impact if we stream full-day exports (we should use background job and notify when ready).
oliver: one more note — we must update release notes to call out schema v2 and export changes, and add migration tips for partners. I'll add to the RFC.
